integrity.source_date_note: The principal source arXiv:2209.11858 was first submitted on 2022-09-23; an AMS meeting abstract from March 2022 described the same project, without the quantitative statement established here.
integrity.verification: The proof was checked line-by-line against Schulz's Lemma 3.2 and Theorem B; the lower-bound mechanism was independently replayed by exact integer computation.

scientific_limitations: The implicit upper-bound constant is not optimized or made explicit.
The theorem counts distinct image values rather than representation multiplicities.
The exponent M is a uniform worst-case exponent; individual definable functions may have smaller growth.
title: Presburger images of power sets have sharp polylogarithmic counting growth
